mechanism: Nicotine induces CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, increasing haloperidol metabolism and reducing its antipsychotic efficacy; nicotine also increases dopamine release which may counteract haloperidol's dopamine antagonism.
action: Monitor antipsychotic efficacy closely; consider haloperidol dose adjustment or nicotine cessation counseling; assess for breakthrough psychotic symptoms in smoking patients.
